title: astragalus kentrophyta subsp. elatus
intro: Astragalus kentrophyta subsp. elatus, commonly known as a species of milkvetch, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family native to the mountainous regions of Pakistan and Afghanistan. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory infections, fever, and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus kentrophyta subsp. elatus include anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been reported to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, although further research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological properties.
